_about: Which project page each Claude Code session belongs to. A session matches by folder first (longest prefix wins), then by title. Add a line when a new project starts; a session in an unknown project folder gets a new draft page made for it automatically.
_redact: Words cut from session titles before they reach the shared vault (people's names). Word -> replacement.
_containers: Folders that hold projects but are not one. A session started directly in one matches by title only; a session in an unknown folder below one gets a new page named after that subfolder.
